summary: Verified LinkedIn Lead Finder Playwright-based search infrastructure. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests passed — cookie save/get flow works with dummy cookie (validation gracefully skipped with warning), Playwright search job launches without errors, connections endpoint returns empty list (login redirect w/ fake cookie) without crashing backend. Regressions: /api/health healthy, /api/content-studio/pillars returns 18. Frontend: LinkedIn Lead Finder loads at /linkedin-search (behind Agent@2024! password), both Post Search & Messaging tabs render, cookie form always visible, 10 default keywords displayed, search trigger button present, connections/compose sections render on Messaging tab.
critical_code_review_comments: linkedin_search.py is 1367 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Should be split into cookie.py, search.py (Playwright + Voyager), messaging.py, connections.py modules.
DRY violation: _playwright_search and _playwright_connections share ~30 lines of identical browser/context/cookie-injection boilerplate. Extract into a shared _playwright_context() helper.
Silent bare except in _playwright_connections search-filter block (line ~303) and _classify_post JSON parse fallback — should log the exception at least at debug level.
active_searches dict is a module-level singleton — multiple concurrent search requests race. Consider per-user or DB-backed job tracking.
MongoDB _id: get_message_log stringifies _id (fine), but posts/runs also do; ensure any list response never leaks raw ObjectId (currently OK).

Playwright resource management: browsers are launched per-keyword. For a search with 10 keywords, that's 10 chromium launches — very slow. Consider reusing one browser context across keywords in _run_search.

_playwright_search waits fixed 3s + 3 scrolls of 1.5s each = ~7.5s per keyword regardless of load. Use page.wait_for_selector on '.feed-shared-update-v2' with short timeout for faster completion when results appear.
Frontend LinkedInSearch.jsx is 751 lines — should be split into <CookieForm/>, <PostSearchTab/>, <MessagingTab/>, <ConnectionsList/> sub-components.
seed_data_creation: Dummy cookie 'TEST_dummy_li_at_cookie_12345' created and cleaned up by test suite (test_zz_cleanup_dummy_cookie).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Playwright search functions cannot be validated end-to-end without a REAL li_at cookie — with any dummy/expired cookie, headless Chromium is redirected to /login and returns 0 posts (verified this does NOT crash the backend). File /app/tests/test_linkedin_playwright.py contains regression + infra tests. Note: tests must live OUTSIDE /app/backend/tests because uvicorn --reload watches that directory and restarts backend mid-test causing timeouts. Moved to /app/tests/. Previous iteration_5 cookie fix still holds.
rca of the issue: N/A — verification of Playwright-based search refactor. Initial test run failed due to uvicorn reload triggered by pytest writing into /app/backend/tests; moved tests to /app/tests/ and all 12 passed.
